ICS 23.100.40 ; 75.120PGD 36Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard (Part 2) specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for equal elbow body made from bar stock for use in oil-hydraulic systems.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standards indicated below:1367 (Part 11) : 2002/ISO 4042 : 1999 Technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners : Part 11 Electroplated coatings2062 : 2011 Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel - Specification14692 (All Parts) ISO general purpose metric screw thread - Tolerances8805 : 2002 General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems9411 : 1980 Specification for elbow coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems
